goal: Expose cumulative message and byte statistics broken down by direction, network, and connection type
Allows node operators and researchers to monitor network bandwidth without continuously polling peer stats
agreement: Tested on node monitoring dashboards with positive feedback (waketraindev)
Support for exposing detailed message metrics with minimal RPC layer logic (stickies-v)
Objection to server-side aggregation resolved by dropping the aggregation commit (stickies-v)
Concept approval without detailed rationale (danielabrozzoni, epiccurious)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it adds cumulative message accounting without altering relay protocols or connection logic
Introduces atomic counters to message send and receive paths without changing peer behavior

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fulfills a user request by adding detailed message breakdowns to getnettotals
Saves node operators from having to poll and aggregate transient per-peer statistics
